essence: The Parāprāsāda seed possesses a radiance comparable to the cosmic conflagration.
The Parāprāsāda seed is as fearsome as the fire of time to all beings.
The Parāprāsāda form is endowed with youthful exuberance.
The power is directed against harmful and strife-causing beings.
Various classes of malevolent supernatural beings are among those targeted.
